name: Haus Fr. Kneisl
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated on a hillside in Soelden, this welcoming guesthouse provides comfortable rooms and friendly personal hospitality after an adventurous day outdoors.

The Giggijoch and Gaislachkogl cable car stations and the village center are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Fr. Kneisl in Soelden offers cosy guestrooms with panoramic views of the Oetztal Alps.
